name: 岩隐寺（暂名；候选栖露岩寺）
status: draft; not implemented; positions to be fixed after the first whitebox
units: metres; +x east (out of the cave, toward the lake); +z south; y up
origin: the centre of the cave-mouth floor, at about 300 m above sea level (proposal; SRTM cannot resolve the cave floor)
yaw_convention: yaw_deg is clockwise from north (-z): 0 = north, 90 = east (+x), 180 = south, 270 = west (-x)
height_note: ground_m is a design proposal (lake 275 m + 101 steps, S17/S08); eye_m is above the local ground. Do not treat either as survey data.
season_time: whitebox neutral daylight first; then G01 岩下柔光 (summer-after-rain morning, reconstructed from the atlas entry); autumn-clear-afternoon variant
fov_note: exterior cameras 44 deg (about 45 mm equivalent); cave interiors 52 deg (about 38 mm) to hold the scale of the cave; see each camera

cameras.name: 湖上远望
cameras.purpose: lake -> rock; the cave mouth is a dark inverted triangle in a huge cliff; the timber building reads small inside it
must_show: 丹霞崖壁与左钟右鼓岩
洞口内的一点木楼檐口/柱
must_not: 现代游船/码头设施抢主体
cameras.notes: From a boat or the wharf. The mouth must read darker than the cliff.

cameras.name: 林间窄路
cameras.purpose: path -> mouth; the cave is hidden until the last turn
must_not: 现代栏杆/指示牌抢主体
cameras.notes: The path should feel 'only wide enough for a single rider' (嘉靖《邵武府志》).

cameras.name: 岩口
cameras.purpose: threshold; the cave opens; the platform underside and the pillar appear
must_show: 平台底/状元柱/短柱/横材
蜃阁檐口从平台后露出
must_not: 平台看起来像贴图/悬浮
cameras.notes: First reveal. Keep the mouth frame; do not fill the frame with the building.

cameras.name: 木楼下部
cameras.purpose: under the platform; the player counts the supports
must_not: 一根柱撑起全部的画面暗示
cameras.notes: The single pillar must read as one support among several, not as a miracle.

cameras.name: 侧向栈道
cameras.purpose: the walkway; the two side pavilions and their different heights
cameras.notes: The 8 m height difference between the two pavilions is the asymmetry to preserve.

cameras.name: 上层小殿回望
cameras.purpose: the upper hall; the cave mouth becomes the bright distant view
cameras.notes: This is the closing beat: the mouth as a bright opening, the building as a dark frame.

to_verify_after_whitebox: every camera stands on walkable ground
the cave mouth is never clipped by the frame in cam01
the timber building reads small in cam01 and cam03
the single pillar does not read as the only support in cam04
the cave roof is not pierced by the third-person eye
the mouth is not blown out in cam06
the two pavilions' height difference reads in cam05
no modern railing/sign dominates any frame
